relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicated that QRHY can significantly decrease vascular permeability in wound healing after anal fistulas.

key_findings: Qingre Huayu recipe accelerated wound healing after anal fistulotomy in rats and reduced vascular permeability.
It increased Ang1, Tie-2 and VE-cadherin and decreased Src.
